latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of SQL to Java entity converter.

- Converts MySQL CREATE TABLE statements to Java entity classes following MyBatis-Plus or JPA conventions.
- Automatically maps MySQL types to Java types and converts snake_case to camelCase for fields and PascalCase for class names.
- Generates framework-specific annotations, including @TableName, @TableId, and appropriate field annotations.
- Supports customization of package name, base class, and annotation style.
- Handles nullable columns, primary key strategies, and includes standard getter/setter generation.
- Produces well-structured, ready-to-use entity classes with imports, comments, and accurate type handling.
